title: FC-CONAN: An Exhaustively Paired Dataset for Robust Evaluation of Retrieval Systems
measurement_description: Evaluation of systems for retrieving appropriate counter-narratives to anti-Muslim hate speech (Islamophobia).
findings: Sparsely annotated datasets, such as the original CONAN, significantly underestimate the performance of counter-narrative retrieval systems because many appropriate pairs are left unlabeled. The new, exhaustively annotated FC-CONAN dataset reveals hundreds of these previously missing appropriate counter-narratives for anti-Muslim hate speech. The study also shows that embedding-based ranking models are more effective and robust to annotation sparsity compared to lexical baselines or more complex hybrid reranking systems.
